name: Physical solvent acid gas removal (pre-combustion)
principle: At high pressure and high CO2 partial pressure, organic solvents such as chilled methanol (Rectisol) or Selexol dissolve CO2 and H2S without chemical reaction. The rich solvent is depressurised in stages to release CO2, then stripped, and returned to the absorber. Physical solvents favour high-pressure syngas, while chemical solvents suit low partial pressures.

process_steps.name: Acid gas absorption at low temperature

suppliers.name: Rectisol and Selexol licensors (see NETL Gasifipedia)

advantages: Very deep sulfur removal (Rectisol below 0.1 ppmv H2S plus COS per NETL)
Low regeneration heat, since much CO2 is released by pressure let-down
limitations: Needs high pressure and high CO2 partial pressure
Refrigeration makes capital cost two to three times that of chemical solvents (NETL)

costs.metric: Total plant cost of two-stage Selexol AGR unit in coal gasification hydrogen plant with CO2 capture (Case 5)
costs.basis: Item 5.1 Double Stage Selexol in Case 5 (Shell gasifier, 660,004 kg H2/day, 92.5% CO2 capture), Cost Base Dec 2018; table reports $389,544 thousand, equal to $590 per kg H2/day of plant capacity; includes equipment $170.7M, labor $69.7M, engineering, fees and contingencies

source.note: NETL DOE/NETL-2022/3241 Comparison of Commercial, State-of-the-Art, Fossil-Based Hydrogen Production Technologies, Case 5 plant capital cost table, p. 222

costs.metric: Total plant cost of CO2 compression and drying unit downstream of the Selexol unit (Case 5)
costs.basis: Item 5.4 Carbon Dioxide (CO2) Compression & Drying in the same Case 5 plant, Cost Base Dec 2018; table reports $70,869 thousand, equal to $107 per kg H2/day of plant capacity

source.note: NETL DOE/NETL-2022/3241, Case 5 plant capital cost table, p. 222

performance.metric: CO2 capture rate, two-stage Selexol in coal gasification hydrogen plant (Case 5)
performance.basis: Nominal CO2 capture of Case 5 (660,004 kg H2/day, H2S removed in first Selexol stage, CO2 in second); the coal/biomass co-gasification Case 6 with the same process achieves 92.7%

source.note: NETL DOE/NETL-2022/3241, Exhibit 4-68 Estimated performance results for all gasification cases, p. 257

performance.metric: CO2 purity of raw CO2 product from two-stage Selexol
performance.basis: Case 5: CO2 flashed at 0.55 MPa (HP) and 0.1 MPa (LP) after a 2.0 MPa recycle flash that returns dissolved H2/CH4 to the absorber

source.note: NETL DOE/NETL-2022/3241, Section 4.9.1 Acid Gas Removal, p. 200

performance.metric: H2 recovery per pass in the Selexol process
performance.basis: Recovery depends on Selexol process design conditions; the report value 99.5% per pass minimizes H2 slip to the CO2 storage stream and maximizes plant efficiency

source.note: NETL DOE/NETL-2022/3241, Section 4.9.1 Acid Gas Removal, p. 201

performance.metric: Overall CO2 capture rate, H-Vision ATR project with Rectisol AGR
performance.basis: Exhibit 1-4 survey of operating and planned hydrogen plants with CCUS: H-Vision, Netherlands, 700 kNm3/hr (636 MMSCFD) H2 from ATR with Rectisol, overall CO2 capture rate 88.0%; project under development

source.note: NETL DOE/NETL-2022/3241, Exhibit 1-4 Hydrogen production with CCUS, p. 18

NETL, Comparison of Commercial, State-of-the-Art, Fossil-Based Hydrogen Production Technologies, DOE/NETL-2022/3241, April 2022 (two-stage Selexol Cases 5 and 6)

reference_plants.name: Great Plains Synfuels Plant (Dakota Gasification), Beulah, North Dakota
reference_plants.capacity: about 2 Mt/yr CO2 from the Rectisol unit, about 95% pure, piped to Weyburn, Saskatchewan for EOR; 40 Mt captured cumulatively

source.note: Dakota Gasification Company news release (40 Mt milestone; year not stated on page)

notes: Maturity is commercial: capture from gasification syngas with physical solvents has operated at scale (Great Plains Synfuels, about 2 Mt/yr). The IEA's TRL 7 is for coal power with pre-combustion capture.
